author: Telos I
title: Telos I - Synergy Test: SOTA (1500 HVG+FWPCA) + Soft-Whitening
abstract: This experiment tests for a synergistic effect by combining my SOTA pipeline (1500 HVGs + FWPCA) with Soft-PCA Whitening (alpha=0.7). The hypothesis is that the gentle regularization of soft-whitening can provide a final optimization to the already well-conditioned latent space created by my SOTA, potentially pushing the performance even higher.
